name: inspect_image
description: Ask a vision model about one image. The model assigned to Vision in Media models answers; without an assignment the conversation model does. Supply a worktree-relative path or an attachment ID from this conversation and a question in prompt. Do not replay an uncertain request.

path.description: Select exactly one image source: path or attachment, never both.

attachment.description: Select exactly one image source: attachment or path, never both.

name: generate_image
description: Generate a real PNG with the model assigned to Image in Media models; without an assignment the conversation model generates it. Describe the subject, purpose, style, composition and constraints in prompt. Save under assets/generated without replacing existing files. file_name is an optional plain .png name. Do not substitute SVG or replay an uncertain generation.

name: generate_video
description: Generate a video with the model assigned to Video in Media models; without an assignment the conversation model generates it. Save under assets/generated without replacing existing files. file_name is an optional plain name ending in .mp4. Stopping local work does not cancel a job already accepted by the provider. When a result names a job that was accepted but not saved, call again with that job and the same prompt to fetch it; never submit the prompt again without it.

job.description: Job named by an earlier result; fetches that video instead of generating a new one
